name: Chipped Corner
idea: A square die with its pin-one corner notched out and the missing piece sliding back in: a chip, and the act of chipping in.

name: Open Package
idea: The chip package drawn as a single-stroke C, open on one side so signals can enter, with the die (the model) held at its centre.

name: One In, One Out
idea: A die stripped to the only two leads it needs, the sensor signal going in on one side and the prediction coming out on the other.

name: Wafer Map
idea: A silicon wafer with its orientation flat, diced into dies, with the centre die lifted out: the one chip that does the job.
